profile.name: Dev Kumar
profile.eyebrow: English & Computer Applications — for students, not for a syllabus
profile.tagline: I teach the parts of English and computers that other lessons skip past. Over three and a half years across teaching, institutional documentation, content creation, and web development — combined with a growing focus on software development and applied AI.
profile.bio: If a worksheet or a lecture isn't landing, I build something that will — quiz sites, lesson platforms, a chatbot that answers grammar questions at midnight. In the classroom itself, it's stories, analogies, and real examples over rules recited from a textbook. Same question drives all of it: what actually gets someone to understand this?
profile.marginNote: started as a teacher, kept getting distracted by the console
